text:
yuki: Quick APAC check 10 days to marketplace public launch. Need owners for JP/SG/IN tiles, SI handoff window for APAC hours, and hardware partner badge verification. Short updates only.

matt: I will own JP/SG tile copy + visual QA. I need translations validated by EOD Fri.

hao: I'll take IN tile and billing parity tests (IN pricing + tax). Will run smoke at 03:00 UTC tomorrow.

sophia: SI handoff: scheduling a +4h post-launch onboarding slot aligned with APAC support (22:00 JST). I'll add SI runbook and invite their engineer.

hw-partner-bot: HW partner status: badge assets uploaded (png, svg). Certification pending due to firmware note. Partner flagged compatibility note for a specific instance type.

yuki: Matt, ensure hero image crops for JP locale (text-safe area). Hao, confirm tax display matches marketplace rules. Sophia, confirm SI engineer can join 22:00 JST.

matt: Will validate responsive crops and push fixes to staging.

hao: Tax display validated in sandbox. One edge-case: prepaid invoices currently show USD only for IN region; billing team flagged. I'll coordinate with billing.

sophia: SI confirmed engineer (Karthik) will join 22:00 JST slot and test tenant provisioning and SSO. Runbook link: /partners/si-apac/onboard-v1.pdf

yuki: Contingency if hardware badge fails certification: we show "Certified pending" ribbon and hold off automated marketplace provisioning for that SKU. Ops-bot, can you gate the SKU?

ops-bot: Feature flag gate applied: sku_hw_compatibility_check enabled. If certification != true, SKU will be hidden from buy flow.

yuki: Metrics to monitor day 0 APAC: launch impressions by region, provisioning success by region, and SKU failure counts. Who adds dashboard tiles?

matt: I'll add JP/SG tiles and set alerts for >2% provisioning failures in JP.

hao: I'll add IN billing metric and an alert for failed invoice currency mapping.

yuki: Owners recap: Matt=JP/SG tiles & hero crops; Hao=IN tile & billing parity; Sophia=SI handoff & runbook; HW-partner-bot=badge assets; Ops-bot=SKU gate. React with :white_check_mark: when green.

matt: :white_check_mark: staging crops fixed.

hao: :white_check_mark: billing test scheduled and patch requested.

sophia: :white_check_mark: SI engineer invited and runbook updated.

hw-partner-bot: :white_check_mark: badge assets uploaded; cert note sent.

yuki: Thanks team 1'll compile the APAC one-pager and send to partners and COMMs.
